name: Coconut crab
desc: The largest land arthropod. It eats fruit and carrion and also kills tortoise hatchlings and other crabs. Adults have almost no predators.
about: The coconut crab is a terrestrial species of giant hermit crab, and is also known as the robber crab or palm thief. It is the largest living terrestrial arthropod, with a weight up to 4.1 kg (9.0 lb).
